elements.text: The orb loads the moth and docks. Cori welcomes you, tours the site, and ends the tour on the mission. PLAY sends the moth out; pause brings him back to his tank.
The orb in the middle, parts turning; the link fills its ring.
In the field, a cocoon splits; the moth unfolds, held there.
The sky comes on in bands, flickering like a screen warming up.
The orb glides bottom-right, moth in its field. The site opens.

texts.line: Welcome. I'm C.O-R.I, Cosmic Operations – Research and Information, steward of this sector. Let me show you the lay of the stars.

elements.text: Cori sparks out of the orb: who she is, then the tour.

texts.line: This orb steers the feed. Turn the stick to move between sections.

elements.text: She lands by the orb: how the stick and buttons work. The route between stops varies.

texts.line: Résumé, GitHub and contact stay up here, wherever you are.

elements.text: She lands on comms, the rail, an entry: what's always there.

texts.line: Last stop. These trails are out of date. You remap them; I'll make it fun.

elements.text: Play: resurvey the sector. You remap; Cori makes it fun. LAUNCH.
The field drops, the moth flies to center; the game's overlay takes the corners.
Back on the site, Cori idles: flies about, rests on a corner, visits the moth in his tank.

· the work is on the site, never behind the game: the game is dessert
· site and game: two places, one overlay, one orb, one Cori
· load (1–4) about 6 s; SKIP › and Esc jump to 4

· the tour never blocks: the site works under it; SKIP TOUR on every stop; NEXT = button 1
· a returning visitor starts docked, no tour; Cori's side button replays it
· calm: no flicker or spin, screens cross-fade, Cori's lines appear whole

knowledge.text: The orb is the transmitter: the source of the projection and the controller of both the site and the game. Splash = the orb in the middle establishing the link, many moving parts (rings, a gear, geometric shapes turning at their own speeds).
Load: the moth comes out of a cocoon in the field at the orb's center; space turns on piece by piece like a screen flickering on; the orb docks bottom-right.
Cori welcomes with a few words of lore: "Welcome. I'm C.O-R.I, Cosmic Operations – Research and Information, steward of this sector. Let me show you the lay of the stars."
Cori is a little random, as in the game: between tour stops and after the tour she picks an idle: fly around, rest on a corner, come talk to the moth in his tank.
The mission (Play tab): resurvey the stars and constellations of this sector. The moth remaps the trails; Cori helps, gathers new and updated info, and makes it fun.
Then a tour of the site first: how the orb works, where you can click (comms, rail, entries). The tour ends on the last tab, Play: the mission, with a touch of lore, then LAUNCH.

On the site the moth swims in the orb's field (a tank) swimming about at random; the tank is where your thumb presses to move. LAUNCH drops the field and he flies to the center. Pause / back: Cori returns to being the site guide, the moth returns to his tank, field up.
Site and game stay separate places, themed and flowing the same: one overlay, the orb controls both, Cori guides in both.
No work info behind the game. The site carries all of it; the game is dessert.
Tour stops: orb → comms (résumé, GitHub, contact) → rail → one entry → Play. One Cori line each, NEXT with button 1 or a click; the flight between stops varies.

agent.brief: First load, Cori's welcome + site tour, the mission on Play, and the site ↔ game handoff, all through the orb.
rules: Work content lives on the site only; nothing about the work is unlocked by play.
The tour never blocks the page: everything stays clickable; SKIP TOUR on every stop; it runs once (localStorage, try/catch), the side button replays it.
Reduced motion: no flicker, no spinning parts, the orb fades to its corner, Cori's lines appear whole.
On the site the moth swims about the tank at random; the tank is the stick disc, where the thumb presses.
LAUNCH: field drops → moth flies to center → site shell fades, HUD fades into the same corners. Pause / Disengage reverses it.
open: Cori's lines per stop (drafts on the screens).
